title: Make an automated tracker
goal: Get ready-to-paste formulas and steps for a real class tracker — you stay the checker.

blocks.title: Tell it your columns, get your formulas
blocks.body:
Let's build something you'll use this week. Think of one tracker you keep — marks, attendance, a watch-list of who's falling behind.

You tell AI what your columns hold and what you want computed. It hands back the exact formula plus a plain how-to. You paste it into your own Google Sheet, and check it on one row you already know. Nothing here lives inside the app — the win lands in your real sheet.

blocks.prompt: Put the request in the order that gets you a formula you can actually paste and trust.

items.text: Name your columns and what each holds (e.g. "marks in C2:C41")
Say plainly what you want computed (total, %, a flag)
Ask for the formula plus step-by-step how-to
Ask it to show the answer on one example row so you can check it

blocks.scaffold: Give me the Google Sheets formulas and a plain step-by-step for a {{artifact}} for my {{gradeBand}} {{subject}} class. Compute [what you want, e.g. attendance % or total marks] from these columns [name them and where they are, e.g. present count in C2:C41, total classes in D2:D41]. Show the result on one example row so I can check it, and keep student names out.

blocks.question: How usable were those formulas and steps when you pasted them into your own sheet?
